description: This file defines an interface named IImbalanceToleranceRule within the Orleans.Placement.Repartitioning namespace. The interface declares a method to determine if a certain level of imbalance between silos is acceptable.

classes.name: IImbalanceToleranceRule
classes.description: An interface representing a rule that controls the degree of imbalance between the number of grain activations in silo exchanges.

methods.name: IsSatisfiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the given imbalance satisfies this rule.
